[F002] All checks pass. Summary of the work follows.

**Finding #1 (high, security — default-allow allowlist):** Replaced the denylist-then-allow scheme in `capabilities_setup_runner.py:101` with a positive `_ALLOWED_HEADS` map (`npm` restricted to `install/ci/ls/list/view/doctor`; `dontpanic`, `echo`, `printf`, `true`, `false` as wildcard-subcommand entries). Heads not on the map are denied unconditionally. The auditor's three exhibits — `git push origin main`, `gh repo delete owner/repo --yes`, `firebase deploy --project real-prod --only functions` — now all return `allow=False`, and a new `npm publish` case is denied via the npm sub-allowlist. Added six tests (`test_allowlist_denies_git_push`, `test_allowlist_denies_gh_repo_delete`, `test_allowlist_denies_firebase_deploy_real_project`, `test_allowlist_denies_npm_publish_subcommand`, `test_allowlist_allows_dontpanic_subcommand`, `test_allowlist_allows_echo_synthetic_step`) and updated the module docstring to describe the default-deny posture.

**Finding #2 (medium, correctness — subprocess spawn crash):** Wrapped `SubprocessRunner.run` in `try/except OSError`, returning `CommandResult(exit_code=127, stdout="", stderr=…)` when the spawn never produces a `CompletedProcess`. Exit code 127 mirrors the Unix "command not found" convention. Added `test_subprocess_runner_returns_capture_on_missing_binary`, `test_subprocess_runner_returns_capture_on_permission_error`, and `test_run_automate_safe_records_step_and_reruns_status_on_spawn_fail
